lastCompletedStory.title: Update the stale quoted implementer task-prompt in cam-next.md

nextStoryContext: US-002 rewrote the quoted implementer task-prompt block (previously lines ~66-70) in both cam-next.md copies (they were byte-identical, so the same edit was applied verbatim to both). The old block showed the stale generic form ('Implement the next user story from scripts/cam/prd.json per your AGENT.md. Branch: <current-branch>. Return with one of the CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS= lines...'). The new block mirrors buildImplementerTaskPrompt's actual output (src/supervisor/task-prompt.ts): 'Implement user story <id> ... This exact story has already been selected by the supervisor; do not self-select a different story.' plus Story ID/Title/Description/Priority/Requires/Branch/Acceptance Criteria placeholders, then the CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS return-line sentence (preserved, per AC3). Regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts via `bun run embed-vendor` since templates/commands/cam-next.md changed; embed-vendor:check is clean. No TS was touched. Remaining known drift not in scope for this story: scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md vs templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md 'Your Task' wording differences (documented in patterns.md, US-002/CAM-224 note) -- not part of US-002/CAM-249's AC set.
